report: Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Hialinosis del menisco interno. Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa. . Impresión: Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa.

No evidence of knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: No significant abnormality identified.

МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Артикулиращият хрущял на костите, формиращи колянната става е запазен. МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда  иперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Заключение: МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2b степен.

The study reveals normal knee joint alignment.   No fracture or bone contusion is seen.  
            No osteocartilagenous lesion is detected.  
            No focal bone marrow edema is noted.  
            Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen.  
              The MCL is intact.    Medial meniscus is not torn.  
              The FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.       
                Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
              Normal course with preserved signal of the ACL is noted.  The PCL is intact.  
              The PF joint surface is preserved.   No subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
               The quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.   
              Normal distal thigh and calg muscle bulk is observed.No definite cartilagenous lesion. 
No definite ligamentous tear. 
No definite meniscal tear.
Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Hialinosis del menisco interno. Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa. Impresión: Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no anterior tibial translation. 
 There is grade III ligamentous sprain (complete tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at femoral attachment. There is chronic tear with scarring of the posteromedial oblique ligament.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.   Grade III ligamentous sprain (complete tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at femoral attachment.  
  Chronic tear with scarring of the posteromedial oblique ligament.
